name: Alert
summary: Inline, in-flow status block. Persistent (not dismissed automatically), tied to a region of the page (not the whole app), and never floating. Four tones — info, success, warning, danger. Optional dismiss control + optional inline action. Distinct from Toast (transient, page-level, floating), Banner (page-level non-dismissible system state), and ValidationMessage (single-field form error).

tone.description: info: status.info.* + Info glyph. success: status.success.* + CheckCircle. warning: status.warning.* + AlertTriangle. danger: status.danger.* + AlertOctagon.

description.description: Required body content. Keep to 2 lines max — if it's longer, route to a docs page.

icon.description: Override the default tone glyph. Pass null to hide the icon entirely.

action.description: Optional inline action — typically a Link or a TextButton. 'Learn more', 'View invoice', 'Reconnect'.

dismissible.description: When true, renders a trailing × icon-button that dismisses the alert. Set onDismiss to handle the close event.

compact.description: Reduces inset to space.inset.sm/md (24 px vertical) and uses type.body.sm. For dense operator surfaces.

live.description: aria-live region politeness. polite for info/success. assertive for warning/danger when the alert appears in response to a user action (form failure, payment declined).

keyboard: Tab - move focus into the alert if it contains an action
rules: role='alert' for danger with live='assertive' (interrupts SR users for time-sensitive failures).
Color is never the only state cue: every tone pairs with a glyph (Info / CheckCircle / AlertTriangle / AlertOctagon).
The dismiss button is an IconButton with aria-label='Dismiss {tone} alert' or aria-label='Dismiss alert: {title}'.
Inline actions inside the description (link or button) are independently tabbable.

do: Use Alert when the message belongs to a specific region (a form, a settings page, a Card body) — not the whole app.
Lead the title with the consequence: 'Payment declined' beats 'There was a problem'.
Pair danger alerts with an inline action that lets the user fix the issue ('Update payment method').
Use polite live regions by default; switch to assertive only when the failure is time-sensitive.
When stacking alerts, render newest at the top.
dont: Don't use Alert for transient confirmations ('Saved') — use Toast.
Don't use Alert for page-level system state (maintenance, outage banners) — use Banner.
Don't use Alert for single-field validation — use ValidationMessage anchored to the field.
Don't auto-dismiss Alerts — they're persistent by design.
Don't fill an Alert with paragraphs of prose. 2 lines max + an action link.

changelog.note: Initial Alert contract. Four tones with paired glyphs. Optional dismiss + inline action. aria-live politeness configurable.
